title: Aliyun Qwen Open Platform Officially Launched: Supports Mobile Phones, PCs, and AI Glasses, Covering More Than Ten Daily Life Fields Such as Renting Apartments and Mailing Packages

content_html:
With the accelerated deployment of artificial intelligence applications, Qwen has undergone a significant ecosystem upgrade. On August 10, the Qwen Open Platform was officially launched, comprehensively opening up service access for three types of terminals: mobile phones, PCs, and AI glasses, to a wide range of ecosystem partners and developers.

As key areas covered in the initial phase, the platform has successfully integrated over ten daily life and high-frequency service scenarios, including logistics transportation, real estate housing, local living, financial management, and automotive services. In practical experience, users no longer need to switch between multiple independent applications. They can directly input their needs in the chat window or click on the "dot indicator" to enter a dedicated intelligent agent, smoothly completing the entire business cycle from initial consultation, solution recommendations, to final orders.

To reduce the entry and adaptation barriers for developers, the Qwen Open Platform provides comprehensive underlying infrastructure support. It not only supports standardized protocol access, one-click authorization, and end-to-end debugging, but also fully integrates core aspects such as account systems, AI payments, and order access.

Industry experts analyze that by deeply integrating high-frequency services such as express tracking, rental price comparisons, and financial information into the conversation window, this move not only significantly reduces user friction during multi-task switching, but also marks that AI assistants are accelerating from simple "information answering" to "intelligent agents" with practical service capabilities.

content_html_zh:
随着人工智能应用的加速部署，Qwen生态系统发生了重大升级。 8月10日，Qwen开放平台正式上线，向广大生态合作伙伴和开发者全面开放手机、PC、AI眼镜三类终端的服务接入。

作为初期覆盖的重点领域，平台已成功整合物流交通、房产住房、本地生活、理财、汽车服务等十多个日常生活和高频服务场景。 在实际体验中，用户不再需要在多个独立的应用程序之间切换。 他们可以直接在聊天窗口输入需求或点击“圆点指示器”进入专属智能座席，顺利完成从最初咨询、方案推荐到最终订单的整个业务周期。

为了降低开发者的进入和适应门槛，Qwen开放平台提供了全面的底层基础设施支持。 不仅支持标准化协议接入、一键授权、端到端调试，还全面集成账户体系、AI支付、订单接入等核心环节。

业内专家分析，通过将快递追踪、租金比价、金融信息等高频服务深度融入对话窗口，此举不仅显着减少了用户多任务切换时的摩擦，也标志着AI助手正在加速从简单的“信息接听”向具有实用服务能力的“智能代理”转变。
